description: This file defines the ModuleScanner class for scanning and analyzing module package files in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It checks for issues like disallowed file types, malicious code, overriding core files, and disabled actions in manifest files. It also provides methods to scan entire directories and packages, and to report issues found.

classes.name: ModuleScanner
classes.description: A class for analyzing module package files, scripts, and manifests for security and integrity issues within SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environments.

methods.name: printToWiki
methods.description: Outputs the default file extensions and blacklisted functions for documentation purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes class properties based on configuration, global variables, and constants.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the list of issues found during scanning.

methods.name: hasIssues
methods.description: Returns true if any issues were detected.

methods.name: isValidExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file has a permitted extension.

methods.name: isConfigFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is a core configuration file.

methods.name: scanDir
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory and analyzes individual files.

methods.name: isPHPFile
methods.description: Checks if the given file contents appear to be PHP code.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Analyzes a given file for security issues, malicious code, and blacklisted functions or classes.

methods.name: sugarFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in SugarCRM’s core files list based on files.md5.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Cleans up a filesystem path, removing redundant elements and preventing directory traversal.

methods.name: scanManifest
methods.description: Scans a manifest file for disabled actions and file overrides, and analyzes its contents.

methods.name: scanCopy
methods.description: Checks if a copy operation would override core SugarCRM files, preventing malicious or unintended overwrites.

methods.name: scanPackage
methods.description: Main method to scan an entire module package directory, including manifest and scripts.

methods.name: displayIssues
methods.description: Outputs all detected issues in a human-readable format for review.

methods.name: getIssuesLog
methods.description: Generates a detailed HTML string log of detected issues.

methods.name: lockConfig
methods.description: Locks the current configuration hash to detect modifications during scanning.

methods.name: checkConfig
methods.description: Checks whether the configuration was altered during the scan process.
